newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KLSE second board divided into five sectors.
newsitem.headline: KLSE second board divided into five sectors.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) will categorise all stocks listed on the second board of the exchange under various sectors with effect from March 3.

It said in a statement released late on Thursday that the 206 companies listed on the second board will be divided into five sectors: consumer products, industrial products, construction, finance and trading/services.

The move is in line with the KLSE's objective to increase the transparency of the market and also for ease of reference in view of the increasing number of companies listed on the second board, it said.
The existing second board index will remain the barometer of the performance of second board companies, the KLSE added.
